mentions.name: Knuckledragger
mentions.description: A proof assistant shallowly based on z3py for constructing and checking formal proofs; it was recently used to prove the infinitude of primes, a theorem z3 cannot prove on its own.
mentions.problem: z3 on its own cannot prove nontrivial theorems such as the infinitude of primes.
